🏆 Certificate verification

Anyone can check here whether an ACS certificate is genuine.

🔍 Check by number

Type the number printed on the certificate below.

The number of a saved career test report can also be checked here.

This is an older type of number.

Also type the percentage printed on the certificate.

📅 How long online checking works

A certificate can be checked online for 5 years from the day it was issued.

The issue date and the valid-until date are printed on the certificate.

After the valid-until date, the certificate does not become fake.

Only its online checking stops.

To stop misuse, the number of checks in a day is limited.

📄 Career test report

A saved career test report can be checked online for 5 years from the day it was saved.

The check shows that this same report is saved in the ACS records.

The sectors in the report are worked out on the student’s own phone.

It is a report of interests, not a proof of ability.

⏳ Extending by 5 more years

The student can extend the checking period by 5 years by paying ₹1000.

If paid before the valid-until date, the new 5 years are added after the old date.

If paid after the valid-until date, a late fee is charged separately.

The late fee is ₹500 for a delay of up to 1 year, and ₹1000 for a longer delay.

Then the new 5 years are counted from the day of payment.

This fee and the late fee are not refunded.

The student does this from their own dashboard.

📥 Getting your own certificate

Within the valid period, the certificate can be downloaded free from the dashboard.

For this, log in and open your course table.

🔑 Open dashboard

📮 Written check from the office

Here the ACS office replies in writing.

The fee is ₹2000 for each request.

It can be done even after the valid-until date.

Its form will be added to this page soon.
